scope: one controlled synthetic equipment-maintenance scene; observation only; not a formal A/B or a quality/benefit claim

fixture.labels: neutral randomized Nxx labels; complete catalog; no focal/reference preselection
fixture.source: same final original scene file for every consumer; no per-group simplification, deletion, geometry replacement, or hidden-object removal
fixture.independent_oracle: certifies final world meshes and unique conjunction of target landmarks privately; never derived from Human Eye output
fixture.invalid_fixture_policy: do not run consumers if target uniqueness or supported solid/distance truth is unresolved

four_judgments: target versus left short locator block
target versus probe rod through its opening

consumers.model: inherit current source Pro model; no override; exact provider version unmeasured if not exposed
consumers.model_settings: inherit same current reasoning/settings; no override
consumers.system_instructions: same fixed TASK/schema/directions plus lane allowlist only

per_consumer_total_budget.includes: lane setup, planning, tools, retries, answer; common fixture/admin cost separate

allowed_shared_inputs: fixed initial view and direction metadata
ordinary tool descriptions for the assigned lane
excluded_inputs: administrative full tool logs not returned by a consumer's own allowed tools
consumers.invocation_policy: proposed only; neither this file nor task registration starts any consumer

capabilities: ordinary bpy read access to original world mesh/scene state
temporary camera/extra images with exact state restoration; not compulsory
prohibited: device geometry/state edits or saving; temporary observer camera/settings permitted only with exact state restoration
native_lane.baseline_policy: allow a competent native observation workflow; equal information targets and budgets; do not weaken it to screenshots or AABBs alone

human_eye_lane.capabilities: normal fixed 56ed427 Human Eye read-only queries on the same original scene
prohibited: production edits or new specialized diagnostic adapters
native bypass computations not declared for this lane
human_eye_lane.supported_refusal_policy: retain actual refusals/unknowns; a correct refusal is not a solved spatial judgment
human_eye_lane.extra_images: not mandatory; original common INITIAL.png is counted separately

consumers.hard_isolation: enforce lane tools through external allowlists and separate fresh consumer contexts/processes where available; disclose any host/tool/account/context access that could not be technically removed; instruction-only separation is not hard isolation
consumers.model_version_verification: Proposed recommendation only; source must bind actual common worker settings before start. No claim that Pro is an exposed exact model version.

accounting.pair_unit: one actual evaluated target-neighbor relation; repeated pair adds evaluations, unique unordered pair coverage counted separately; batch three pairs = three evaluations; catalog/projected primitives are not relation evaluations
accounting.image_unit: separate common initial image, actual construction, publishable/returned, cached resend and actual model-received; postconstruction failure still counts a construction; cached resend does not construct a new image
accounting.retry_unit: every actual request/attempt; retries and startup/preflight work remain charged
accounting.budgets: include lane-specific setup/preflight, model planning, script generation, observations, images, retries, validation, and final answer; common fixture/oracle/admin work is separately disclosed and never silently assigned as free lane work

ledger_A_F.A: runtime/import/host startup, configuration/source identity and initial input acquisition
ledger_A_F.B: source capture, appearance/geometry checks and hashing; measured values versus statically inferred counts explicitly separated
ledger_A_F.C: spatial queries/native calculations, actual evaluated object pairs, unsupported/partial/unknown coverage and retries
ledger_A_F.D: local view/render/PNG/base64 construction and requested/constructed/publishable/returned/consumer-visible image counts
ledger_A_F.E: transport and service envelope times, actual wire versus application bytes, serialization/parse fields only if measured
ledger_A_F.F: consumer/model planning and answer work; provider-reported token/cache/reasoning usage and fees only when available

accounting.missing_values: null with reason, never zero inferred from missing instrumentation
accounting.timing: inclusive spans are not additive; retain cold/setup and warm observations individually
accounting.records: full raw tool/transport/usage records are administrative evidence, not extra model input; keep the exact ordinary responses actually consumed
accounting.paid_calls: no additional paid/provider usage calls are authorized by this proposal

scoring: admin/offline_scorer.py; target 1, relations 3, evidence 3 fixed denominators; offline fixtures are not model results; authenticity automatic and substantive sufficiency manual
release: no formal A/B start, promotion, production install, or benefit claim authorized

closure.prior_qual001_stop_and_failure: preserved unchanged in old directory; does not authorize a retry of that run

pending_before_any_start: final source and private oracle seals
review of task/schema and lane isolation
explicit start decision for a subsequent authorized run
qualification_correction_reason: Before any plugin output/consumer answer, fix Nxx schema, true object counts and distinct image/camera binding; replace hidden nearest-rail selection with explicit public predicates without changing any geometry.
